Guides / Start here / FAQ

FAQ

Quick answers to the questions trainers ask most.

Why didn't my team catch that Pokémon?

Only what your Catch rules want gets a ball. By default: new species, Shiny, Void, Prismatic, perfect IVs and legendaries. Turn on "New looks", add it to the Catch list, or switch on "Catch everything".

Why did a Pokémon run away?

Ordinary wild Pokémon get 4 balls before the team finishes the battle, and from turn 7 they can flee. What your rules always want is never knocked out: it gets 40 balls (Catch list, legendaries) or 25 (other wants), Shiny/Void/Prismatic get every ball you have. Out of balls, it runs.

My Pokémon stopped levelling.

You hit the level cap: the next Gym's ace + 3 (21 / 31 / 41 / 51 / 61 / 71 / 81 / 91). Beat that Gym to raise it. Power-ups (Candy) still make it stronger. See Levels & EXP.

A traded Pokémon dropped levels.

Pokémon above your level cap "shadow drop" to it. Their real level comes back step by step as your badges raise the cap, and they trade on at their real level.

What are my odds of breeding a Shiny, Void or Prismatic baby?

Use the Breeding calculator: pick both parents, their looks, your rank and Shiny Charm, and it shows the baby, the chance per egg of every look (all 8 combinations), Perfect IVs and Alpha, how many eggs for a 50% or 90% shot, and how fast eggs come and hatch with a nanny and an egg warmer. Each parent with a look adds to its chance, and parents caught on different islands double the base odds.

How do I get legendaries?

Wild legendaries live on their island and wake once you've beaten that island's Gym and hold 3 badges. Raids are the steady source. Mythicals only come from Raids. See Legendaries & Mythicals.

How do I evolve Eevee (or any branching line)?

Branching lines never evolve on their own. When one reaches an evolution, the PC shows a green arrow: press Evolve and pick. Stones work from the Bag any time. Friendship evolutions (Espeon, Umbreon, Sylveon, Crobat…) open at Lv 20, or at any level once it's a Good Buddy (see Buddy).

Can I stop my Pokémon from evolving?

Yes, in Catch rules → Evolving. Switch Auto-evolve off and nothing evolves on its own: Pokémon wait as "Ready to evolve" (green arrow in the PC) until you press Evolve. Or keep it on and turn on Living dex: your best copy of each species stays as it is, and extra copies still evolve. An Everstone stops one Pokémon.

How do I keep every copy of a species?

Add it to the Never send list (Catch rules → Never send → Species, or the lock on its Pokédex page). Auto-send and Send duplicates then skip every copy. See the Professor.

How do trade evolutions work?

Trade it to a friend, or use a Linking Cord (Mart, $2,500).

Where do Master Balls come from?

See Master Ball: Raids (50,000+ damage), Gym Drake's badge, island checklists, the Stamp book, achievements and the rare legendary drop.

Does the game keep hunting while closed?

Yes, 3× slower than live, up to your Camping Gear cap (120 battles + 60 per level). Hidden to the tray it hunts at full speed. Bosses and Gyms wait for you.

What are Glimmer and Bounty Tickets?

Glimmer is the Night Market currency (earned from your special finds). Bounty Tickets come from Bounties, the Tower, the Stamp book and raids, and buy Style items and Game Corner capsules.

Can I lose a rare find?

A Shiny, Void, Prismatic or a new costume look is never knocked out by your team. If "Battle rare finds myself" is on, it waits 2 minutes for you. Out of balls, it runs, so keep auto-restock on.

Why can't I sell on the Night Market yet?

New trainers can buy right away, but selling opens 2 days after you start playing online. Once you're selling, you can change a listing's price without taking it down (see Night Market).

My panels moved after an update.

From v0.54 your panel layout and monitor settings are also kept in your save folder, so they stay put through updates. If one is ever lost, the game brings it back from there.

Do I have to pay for anything?

No. Tallgrass is free and nothing is behind a paywall. If you want to follow its development, Settings → Help → Support opens the Patreon page.

Is Tallgrass official?

No. It is a free fan-made game, not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures or The Pokémon Company.
